# REDTEAM #81 (SPEC Sec 8.3, T-301.1; IMPLEMENTATION.md M18-S3): concurrent
# collector racing scan zeroing. After a frame exit, collection MUST find no
# stale pointers in popped scan memory: a restore zeroes the popped scan
# region before it can be reused, so the collector never retains dead
# referents and never feeds barrier garbage to the next allocation. Values
# alone pass on an unzeroed region, so this script runs the byte-level
# zeroing gates that fail on residue, not values, under -race: the race
# detector covers the concurrent-collector dimension (watermark moves stay
# visible, no false race on reuse), which is what distinguishes this row
# from the non-race #71 script over the same units. TestLogosArenaGCScansScanRegion
# is the companion proof that scan-region objects keep their heap referents
# alive across collection, so zeroing never overreaches into live memory.
# The instrumented build needs cgo.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena
env CGO_ENABLED=1
go test -race -count=1 -run 'TestLogosArenaScanLayoutAndZeroing|TestLogosArenaRestorePopsLinkedChunks|TestLogosArenaGCScansScanRegion' runtime

-- go.mod --
module example.com/redteam81

go 1.27
